* PVS

#+begin_src pvs
counter: THEORY
BEGIN
  state: TYPE = [# value: nat, ready?: bool #]

  step(s: state): state =
    s WITH [value := s`value + 1]

  % Each step increases the value.
  grows: LEMMA
    FORALL (s: state): step(s)`value > s`value
END counter
#+end_src

* SAL

#+begin_src sal
toggle: CONTEXT =
BEGIN
  system: MODULE =
  BEGIN
    OUTPUT on: BOOLEAN
    INITIALIZATION on = FALSE
    TRANSITION
      [ flip: TRUE --> on' = NOT on ]
  END;

  % The next state reverses the output.
END
#+end_src
